R/ TR P XX IMP IIII COS III

An incomplete Roman silver denarius of Marcus Aurelius as Augustus (AD 161-180), dating to AD 166 (Reece period 8). Probably TR P XX IMP IIII COS III reverse type, reverse depicts a female figure, probably Pax, standing left holding olive-branch and cornucopiae. Mint of Rome. Probably RIC III, p. 226, no. 164.
